Vocalist Rebecca Kilgore was born in Waltham, Massachusetts. Although her father was a schooled musician and composer, Rebecca describes herself as a “closet” singer/guitarist during high school and she had no aspirations to a career as a professional musician. She moved to Portland in 1979 and began singing with local musicians, most often with the Wholly Cats, a local swing band. The Portland surroundings provided diverse musical influences and Rebecca sang in Western swing, country and Django-derived jazz groups. In the early ‘90s she began a fruitful relationship with pianist/songwriter Dave Frishberg. She is currently enjoying a productive association with Arbors Records and their roster of fine band leaders and arrangers. Rebecca works regularly in the Portland area and is becoming a familiar voice at jazz parties and festivals across the country.
Rebecca was interviewed on September 13, 1997 at the Allegheny Jazz Party in Chautauqua, NY by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
